text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On the way back home with Mejiro
Dober, we
spot a poster of Mejiro
McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Passerby A
text_block_list.text: Hey look, it's a poster of McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Passerby B
text_block_list.text:
Oh, yeah. She ran a great race the other
day, but
that's just par for the course for
a Mejiro!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...I'm fine. I was just thinking how right
they are.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I was just thinking, "Yep, that's
McQueen
for you."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even the way she carries herself in
day-to-day life
is just different... All
while shouldering way more

responsibility than I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Even the way she carries herself in
day-to-day life
is just different... All
while shouldering way more

responsibility than I do.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
She has this aura of dignity and the skills
to back
it up... No one can represent our
family like her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Just then, we pass by a bookstore and
spot
someone very familiar.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
M-McQueen?! Didn't expect to run into
you
here...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
D-Dober?! I was, erm... just passing by,
you see,
and certainly not here to
purchase the special
feature on Yutaka
or anything...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yutaka? Wait... that Yutaka?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Gasp! Wait, Dober... you know Yutaka?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The mention of Yutaka excites them
both, and we
end up ducking into a
diner so they can chat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Uh, yes? Oh, McQueen, did you see
the thing
from the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Uh, yes! Oh, McQueen, did you see the
thing
from the other day?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw it in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I saw it in real time!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you keep up with things in real
time? I like to
wait and binge everything
at once.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, well, that lets you savor things at
your own
pace, I suppose...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But is it not thrilling to experience things
as they
are happening?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I guess, but the location is, well,
you know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Location? Oh, if you mean watching in
person, I
suppose it is rather far...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Far? What do you mean? You can buy
magazines
anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Magazines? I'm talking about the
baseball
stadium...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: What? We're talking about Yutaka, the manga artist, aren't we? The one behind Burn Bright! Shibasaki Girls' Soccer Club.
choice_data_list: ...Aren't the two of you talking about completely different things?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! I thought we were talking about
Yutaka the
baseball player!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sorry... I just got so excited when I
thought we
liked the same thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Same here... I thought we'd found a
common
interest... So there's a manga
artist named Yutaka
too, is there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I imagine their work must be fascinating,
given
how passionately you talk about it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We'll have to chat again sometime
soon,
and then you can tell me all about
them!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I had no idea McQueen had a fangirl side to her...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Guess so.
choice_data_list: Everyone has so many different sides to them.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Multifaceted... Yeah, I guess so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to see more... See what other
sides there
are to McQueen.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm curious to see what other sides
there are
to McQueen, sides I don't
know about...
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend them some manga?
How about we go watch a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, I don't want to be pushy or
anything...
choice_data_list: Why don't you lend them some manga?
How about we go watch a baseball game together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...But don't you think I'll come across as
too
pushy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Sure, but still... Well, I guess it couldn't
hurt to
ask...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...That's true. I'll try asking if she'd like
to borrow
some, then.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I see the two of them
happily
conversing in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I see the two of them
happily
conversing in the cafeteria.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that can't be! We have to wait until
the next
volume to find out what
happens to the club?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Ahem. Apologies for getting
carried away.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's just... You had the exact
same
reaction I did, so I was surprised...
and happy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to Yutaka the manga artist, the
two of
them become a little closer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That's... a good idea. I've been wanting
to go to
one, so I think I'll ask her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the three of us are on
our way
back from a baseball game...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, the three of us are on
our way
back from a baseball game...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I still cannot believe how much I
screamed
during the game... How
mortifying...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Don't be embarrassed! That home run
was
scream-worthy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?! That decisive swing was
proof that
he hadn't given up despite
how far behind they
were!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
The tension right before he swung was
palpable...
I can see why you like
baseball so much. I'd love
to learn more.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Truly? Then we must attend another game sometime!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I'd like that!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The two chat enthusiastically about the
game the
entire way home.
